name: top_grasp
description: Come straight down over the object's centre and close across its top.

depth_frac.meaning: how far below the object's top the fingertips go, as a fraction of its height (0.5 = half way down); the fingers are ~5 cm long, so deeper than ~4.5 cm puts the palm on the top

yaw_offset_deg.meaning: gripper rotation about vertical relative to the perceived orientation; the result is folded to +-45 deg

approach_height.meaning: hover height above the object's top before descending (does not change the grasp)

descend_speed.meaning: descent speed from the hover pose, m/s

clear_side.meaning: 1 = on a square top, turn the hand 90 deg if that keeps it farther from tall neighbouring objects (the hand is ~22 cm long along the finger direction); 0 = off

check: fingers closed on something: 3 mm < finger width < 76 mm
